entries.summary: At a re-enable one frame after a disable, OpenModelica resets the PIDWithReset integrator (Change fires again) and the engine does not (Change held true on two consecutive frames is one rising edge).

subject.observation: t=382 s, enable false at 377 s and true at 382 s, TSup 290 K from 382 s

evidence.summary: The engine's valve signal over the probe frames, as bits: 0.036, 0.051 and 0.066 at 382, 387 and 392 s.
OpenModelica 1.25.1 running upstream CoolingCoilValve on the probe frames: reset at 382 s, then 0, 0.015 and 0.030.

entries.disposition: Owner decision pending in issue #800 (https://github.com/jscott3201/open-control-engine/issues/800): whether HostTick v1 should count each pulse of a Boolean held true on consecutive frames as an event, as Modelica does, or keep one rising edge; no engine behaviour changed with this entry.

entries.summary: OnCounter fed by Change of a signal that changes on consecutive frames: OpenModelica counts every change, the engine one per run of consecutive changes.

subject.observation: u changes at 2, 3, 5, 7, 8 and 9 s at 1 s frames; counts part from 3 s

evidence.summary: The engine's count over the ten frames: 3, 3, 4, 4, 4, 5, 5, 6, 6, 6.
